ai.title: Nvidia CFO handed top job after Huang quits
ai.description: WASHINGTON, D.C./SAN FRANCISCO — Colette Kress spent years as the one Nvidia executive willing to check CEO Jensen Huang’s enormous, often risky ambitions. As he drove the chipmaker deeper into multibillion-dollar artificial intelligence (AI) investments, she pushed back, according to two people familiar with the matter on Thursday.
